segments.text: We first tried IoT cold-chain sensor in 208. At the time, efficiency needs mattered because we needed visibility across branches.
The biggest issue was Skills gap. Without steady power in Enugu, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after IoT cold-chain sensor—we saw Customer retention within 12 months.
Policy-wise, Tax compliance shaped our move. We adjusted by Partnership with fintech.
Data helped; even a simple regression model gave us clearer demand patterns during New Year.
